title: Haunted Passport
summary: Selective-disclosure credentials on Tari Ootle Esmeralda, with issuer, holder, verifier and public observer views. The issuer creates stealth outputs with a public tier floor and can freeze or revoke them; the holder answers a fresh ownership challenge. The issuer can read exact values, repeated presentations of the same output are linkable, and the verifier trusts its indexer. The hosted issuer desk is closed; issuance requires the separate local issuer service. October 31 review covered the creator’s forum and Bluesky announcements, MIT repository and public website. The recording shows public explanations and deployment links; no wallet connection, credential issuance or proof signing was performed.
cardSummary: Present age, membership or reputation credentials while revealing a qualifying threshold instead of the exact value.
